purpose: Preserve parallel task publications, executions, research results and audits as first-class immutable evidence while keeping operational dispatch/terminal decisions explicit and single-valued only at the control layer.

trigger_policy.contradictory_results: KEEP_ALL; CLASSIFY_CONTRADICTION; DO_NOT ERASE OR SILENTLY SUPERSEDE EVIDENCE

reference_passes.rule: Every recorded pass pins the exact intake Result/publication evidence set and preserves findings, reviewer and independence disclosure. New synthesis writes list the complete current reference set without truncation. Zero references require reference_review_status=NOT_PERFORMED; otherwise status is RECORDED, which does not imply independent or sufficient review. Explicit task-level substantive checks still apply.
reference_passes.pass_number: Unique positive integer label within an intake; no ordering or method is implied.
reference_passes.pass_kind: A nonempty method label describing the actual check; historical semantic and adversarial labels remain valid examples.

terminal_rule: Task-terminal control requires synthesis over the exact complete Result set, a valid terminal control disposition, and the existing per-Result review, independence, authorization and follow-up conditions. Reference count alone neither grants nor removes authority. Nonterminal synthesis, including RETURN_FOR_MORE_RESEARCH, may record zero, one or any useful number of references without claiming unperformed review. Individual Results remain independently citable.
compatibility: research_task_publication_resolutions.json may continue to expose a single operational_publication_id for runtime continuity. Fields named quarantined_publication_ids are legacy compatibility spelling only and must not mean rejection or deletion when the same IDs appear in retained_parallel_publication_ids. Historical two-pass records and pass_1_id/pass_2_id aliases remain readable without rewriting their bytes. New inline reference projections use the complete reference_pass_ids list and truthful reference_review_status; aliases do not impose a method sequence. Manual historical JSON records do not receive write-time completeness certification. Unknown or duplicate references remain invalid; a known strict subset cannot provide current synthesis authority.
reference_snapshot_rule: A synthesis is an immutable snapshot of its declared real reference IDs. Historical audit validates those references without claiming to reconstruct their original write-time universe. The public writer checks the complete current set before and after exclusive creation. A later reference leaves old bytes valid but makes that snapshot stale for current authority; append a new complete synthesis. Runtime selects by exact set, never timestamp, and rejects competing current snapshots. Publication resolutions must explicitly point to that current synthesis.
